# EntityAndSearch — Randy Holland

> Fractional SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategist based in Vancouver, WA, serving Clark County and the Portland, Oregon metro. Randy Holland helps local service businesses and marketing agencies get found in Google — and cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews.

Randy Holland has 15+ years in technical SEO (WSU Vancouver alumnus, former senior technical resource at a Portland-metro agency). EntityAndSearch focuses on making brands legible to both traditional search and generative AI: technical SEO audits, schema and entity architecture, and AI-search (GEO/AIO) strategy — delivered white-label for agencies or directly for high-ticket local businesses such as custom home builders and home-service providers. Contact: hello@entityandsearch.com.

## Case Studies & Technical Work
- [GEO/AEO Vulnerability Protocol](https://entityandsearch.com/geo-audit-case/): Auditing how exposed a brand's content is to AI answer engines, and where its answers are vulnerable.
- [Entity Architecture](https://entityandsearch.com/entity-schema-case/): Building a consolidated entity and schema graph so search engines and LLMs correctly understand a brand.
- [Programmatic Query Fanout & LLM Alignment](https://entityandsearch.com/query-fanout-case/): Modeling the sub-queries AI engines generate (query fan-out) and aligning content to them.
- [Geographic URL Architecture & Siloing](https://entityandsearch.com/geographic-architecture/): Structuring multi-location URLs and internal siloing for geographic and local relevance.
- [The 921K Phantom Page Loop](https://entityandsearch.com/phantom-crawl-loop/): Diagnosing and eliminating a crawl trap that generated 921,000 phantom URLs.
- [Enterprise Content Decay & AI Overview Alignment](https://entityandsearch.com/roofing-decay-case/): Reversing enterprise content decay and realigning it for Google's AI Overviews.
- [JavaScript Rendering Diagnostics](https://entityandsearch.com/medical-coding-case/): Diagnosing indexation failures caused by client-side JavaScript rendering.
- [Proactive IA & Technical SEO Audit (B2B FinTech)](https://entityandsearch.com/nexus-fintech-audit-case/): Information-architecture and technical SEO audit for a national B2B fintech.
- [Enterprise eCommerce SEO Blueprint (Wayfair Case Study)](https://entityandsearch.com/wayfair-pitch-case/): A technical and IA blueprint for enterprise e-commerce SEO at scale.
- [Enterprise IA Blueprint](https://entityandsearch.com/signage-ia-case/): An information-architecture blueprint for a large enterprise website.
- [Intent Alignment Case Study](https://entityandsearch.com/container-intent-case/): Aligning page content and structure to searcher intent.
- [Global Enterprise Cloud Security Migration](https://entityandsearch.com/enterprise-cloud-security-migration/): Preserving and growing organic visibility through a large enterprise site migration.
- [The SEO Grid](https://entityandsearch.com/seo-grid-case/): A systematic framework for prioritizing SEO work by impact and effort.
- [BugCast: Predictive Weather SEO](https://entityandsearch.com/bugcast-case/): A predictive, weather-driven programmatic SEO concept.

## Selected Articles

- [The "Geographic Advantage" Is Real: Google's Feb 2026 Update and Local SEO](https://entityandsearch.com/blog/the-geographic-advantage-is-real-why-google-s-feb-2026-update-is/): Why local relevance is a growing ranking and AI-visibility advantage.
- [What AI Really Says About Your Business — and Where It Gets the Information](https://entityandsearch.com/blog/what-ai-really-says-about-your-business-and-where-it-gets-the-inf/): Auditing one local brand across four AI search engines to expose gaps and inaccuracies.
- [The $20 "Raw DOM + Claude" Hack for AI Search Optimization](https://entityandsearch.com/blog/stop-buying-500-mo-geo-tools-the-20-raw-dom-claude-hack-for-ai-se/): A low-cost alternative to expensive enterprise GEO tools.
- [JavaScript SEO Audit Fails: Rendering, Indexing, and How to Fix Them](https://entityandsearch.com/blog/javascript-seo-audit-fails-rendering-indexing-and-how-to-fix-them/): Why standard audits miss rendering issues in React/Angular/Vue sites, and how to fix them.
